summary: Russian drone strikes killed a child in Kyiv's Pechersk district and hit civilian infrastructure near Mykhaila Boichuka Street, while waves of UAVs targeted multiple Ukrainian regions including Lutsk, Poltava, Mykolaiv, and Chernihiv. Ukrainian drones struck two oil depots in Russia's Rostov region, and DeepState confirmed Russian occupation of Novooleksandrivka with advances near Yurkivka and Vasylivka. Zelensky rejected the 'Anchorage agreements' and outlined three US-proposed de-escalation steps including a mutual halt to energy infrastructure strikes.
key_points: Russian drone strike on a residential building in Kyiv's Pechersk district killed a child, with another impact near Mykhaila Boichuka Street hitting civilian infrastructure. (Source: @eRadarrua/116663, @mon1tor_ua/75698)
DeepState map update confirms Russian forces occupied Novooleksandrivka and advanced near Yurkivka and Vasylivka on the eastern front. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23861)

Ukrainian drones attacked two oil depots in southern Russia's Rostov region, damaging administrative buildings in Kagalniksky district, with drones also reported downed near Taganrog. (Source: @UkraineNow/84282)

Zelensky stated the 'Anchorage agreements' recognizing Russian sovereignty over Crimea, Donbas, and occupied parts of Kherson and Zaporizhzhia are no longer subject to negotiation. (Source: @UkraineNow/84285)

Multiple Russian UAV groups tracked across Ukraine: jet-powered drones over Mykolaiv, Poltava, Kherson, Dnipropetrovsk, Chernihiv, and Zhytomyr regions, with Shaheds targeting Lutsk and Korosten. (Source: @kpszsu/80067, @kpszsu/80070, @kpszsu/80041, @mon1tor_ua/75674)
EU approved nearly €3 billion payment to Ukraine under Ukraine Facility program, with Norway contributing €92 million as the first non-EU country to join the financing. (Source: @UkraineNow/84279)
67th OMBr 'Iron Falcons' conducted drone drops on Russian positions near Fedorivka on the Kramatorsk sector. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23860)
Russian forces struck a drone assembly site in Borispol where engines for 'Flamingo' UAVs were stored, according to the Russian Defense Ministry. (Source: @tass_agency/397243)

sections.executive_summary: Russian drone strikes killed a child in Kyiv's Pechersk district and damaged civilian infrastructure near Mykhaila Boichuka Street amid widespread UAV activity across at least eight Ukrainian regions. Ukrainian drones retaliated by striking two oil depots in Russia's Rostov region. On the ground, DeepState confirmed Russian occupation of Novooleksandrivka with advances near Yurkivka and Vasylivka, while Zelensky rejected the 'Anchorage agreements' and outlined three US-proposed de-escalation steps.

points: Zelensky outlined three US-proposed de-escalation steps: mutual cessation of strikes on energy infrastructure, restoration of the Black Sea grain corridor, and a trilateral meeting of the US, Ukraine, and Russia. Ukraine expressed readiness for an energy ceasefire and openness to any formats. (Source: @UkraineNow/84281)

Zelensky stated that the 'Anchorage agreements' — which would imply recognition of Russian sovereignty over Crimea, Donbas, and withdrawal of Ukrainian forces from parts of Kherson and Zaporizhzhia regions — are no longer subject to negotiation. He credited the Armed Forces of Ukraine with playing the most significant role in removing this from the agenda. (Source: @UkraineNow/84285, @ukr_leaks_eng/33496)

EU approved nearly €3 billion in funding for Ukraine under the Ukraine Facility program after Ukraine completed 10 required steps, having fulfilled 84 of 95 total reforms and measures. Norway became the first non-EU country to contribute, providing €92 million. (Source: @UkraineNow/84279)

Ukrainian demographer Ella Libanova warned that sending young people to the front lines would undermine Ukraine's future, stating mortality rates would be significantly higher among younger individuals than older ones. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33483)

A single father has reportedly been held in the basement of the Stryi Territorial Conscription Center in Lviv region for a week, with his sister caring for his 14-year-old child. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33488)

The number of Ukrainians under temporary protection in Poland decreased by approximately 40,000 over the past six months due to a deteriorating environment and reduction in benefits, according to Ukrainian Ambassador to Poland Vasily Bondar. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33503)

ISW reported that Ukrainian forces advanced in Kharkiv, Donetsk, and Zaporizhzhia regions over recent days, disrupting a series of Russian offensive operations across most front-line directions. (Source: @UkraineNow/84280)

Russian drone strikes on Kyiv killed a child when a residential building in the Pechersk district was hit, with a separate impact on civilian infrastructure or houses near Mykhaila Boichuka Street. (Source: @eRadarrua/116663, @mon1tor_ua/75698)
Russian forces struck a drone assembly site in Borispol where engines for 'Flamingo' UAVs were stored, according to the Russian Defense Ministry. (Source: @tass_agency/397243)

A Russian UAV attack on Ulyanovsk injured two teenagers, according to updated data from the regional Health Ministry. A passenger train also sustained damage on the railway between Ulyanovsk and Samara regions. (Source: @tass_agency/397248, @tass_agency/397246)
The governor of Omsk region reported that three residents were killed in a Ukrainian Armed Forces attack on a humanitarian convoy in the SVO zone. (Source: @tass_agency/397267)
Russian forces occupied Novooleksandrivka and advanced near Yurkivka and Vasylivka, according to DeepState map updates. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23861)

Multiple groups of Russian UAVs were tracked across Ukrainian airspace: jet-powered drones over Mykolaiv region near Bashtanka heading northwest, over Poltava region near Reshetilivka toward Khorol, and over Kherson and Dnipropetrovsk regions. (Source: @kpszsu/80067, @kpszsu/80064, @eRadarrua/116689)

DeepState confirmed Russian forces occupied Novooleksandrivka and made advances near Yurkivka and Vasylivka, indicating continued Russian pressure on this sector of the front. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23861)

The 67th OMBr 'Iron Falcons' conducted drone drops on Russian positions near Fedorivka on the Kramatorsk sector, indicating active Ukrainian engagement along this portion of the eastern front. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23860)
ISW reported that Ukrainian forces advanced in Donetsk region over recent days, disrupting Russian offensive operations across most front-line directions. (Source: @UkraineNow/84280)

Russian forces struck a drone assembly site in Borispol where engines for 'Flamingo' UAVs were stored, per the Russian Defense Ministry, suggesting Russian targeting of Ukrainian drone production infrastructure. (Source: @tass_agency/397243)
Russian strike UAVs were detected on northern Chernihiv region near or past Horodnya heading toward Chernihiv, indicating drone activity along the northern border axis. (Source: @kpszsu/80041)

A jet-powered drone was tracked from northern Kyiv region into Zhytomyr region heading toward Zhytomyr, and another was reported over Borodianka in Kyiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/80063, @eRadarrua/116644)

Kyiv experienced an air alert with drone threat at yellow level, with all-clear declared at 09:44. A Shahed drone was observed over central Kyiv for approximately three minutes before falling, with the air alert issued only 30-60 seconds before potential impact. (Source: @eRadarrua/116662, @eRadarrua/116645, @mon1tor_ua/75699)

One drone was destroyed in the Kyiv area, with a remaining drone circling from Brovary to Boryspil. Another drone was tracked heading toward Kaharlyk and then Obukhiv/Vasylkiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/116637, @eRadarrua/116682)

Ukrainian drones attacked two oil depots in southern Russia's Rostov region, with the governor reporting damage to administrative buildings in Kagalniksky district from falling UAV debris. Drones were also reported downed in Taganrog and Neklinovsky district. (Source: @UkraineNow/84282)

A jet-powered drone was tracked in the Bashtanka area of Mykolaiv region heading northwest, with another detected on the border of Odesa and Mykolaiv regions heading north. (Source: @kpszsu/80067, @kpszsu/80052)
Strike UAVs were detected heading toward Kryvyi Rih from the east, with a group of strike drones also reported in the same direction. (Source: @kpszsu/80033, @kpszsu/80035)
Four 'Bandarol' drones were reported heading toward Mykolaiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75692)
Jet-powered drones were reported over Kherson region, with one drone group confirmed in the area. (Source: @eRadarrua/116689)

Russian drone strikes on Kyiv killed a child in a residential building in Pechersk district and hit civilian infrastructure near Mykhaila Boichuka Street, with the air alert issued only 30-60 seconds before potential impact. (Source: @eRadarrua/116663, @mon1tor_ua/75698, @mon1tor_ua/75699)

Shahed drones targeted Lutsk multiple times, with alerts indicating drones entering the city over the Lypyny and KRZ areas. A jet-powered Shahed was also reported heading toward Korosten. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75674, @mon1tor_ua/75678, @mon1tor_ua/75694)

A jet-powered drone was tracked over the Kaniv reservoir heading west, and another over Poltava region near Reshetilivka toward Khorol, with a subsequent report of a jet-powered drone near Khorol heading toward Cherkasy region. (Source: @kpszsu/80036, @kpszsu/80064, @eRadarrua/116668)
Enemy UAVs were detected in the Pereshchepyne area of Dnipropetrovsk region heading west, with strike drones also heading toward Kryvyi Rih from the east. (Source: @kpszsu/80062, @kpszsu/80033)
A jet-powered drone was tracked from Kyiv region toward Zhytomyr, and another was reported over Khmelnytskyi region heading toward Khmelnytskyi city. (Source: @kpszsu/80063, @eRadarrua/116644)

Russian forces have been destroying data centers in Ukraine for three weeks, which is expected to lead to prolonged disruptions in communication and internet services, according to a representative of an internet traffic exchange point. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33486)

sections.threat_assessment: The killing of a child in Kyiv's Pechersk district underscores the persistent threat to civilian areas from Russian drone strikes, compounded by critically delayed air alert systems that gave Kyiv residents only 30-60 seconds of warning. The simultaneous multi-axis drone campaign — spanning from Chernihiv to Odesa and from Lutsk to Khmelnytskyi — indicates Russia maintains the capacity to saturate Ukrainian air defenses across broad geographic areas. Russian territorial gains at Novooleksandrivka and advances near Yurkivka and Vasylivka suggest sustained offensive pressure on the eastern front despite Ukrainian counterattacks.
sections.regional_response: The EU's approval of nearly €3 billion under the Ukraine Facility program, combined with Norway's €92 million contribution, signals continued European financial commitment. However, UK cuts to the 'Homes for Ukraine' program by 70% — reducing monthly payments from £350 to £100 — and Marine Le Pen's pledge to halt financial assistance to Ukraine if elected reflect growing political fatigue in parts of Europe. The decrease of approximately 40,000 Ukrainians under temporary protection in Poland further indicates a deteriorating environment for displaced populations.
sections.intelligence_notes: Zelensky's firm rejection of the 'Anchorage agreements' and his openness to an energy infrastructure ceasefire represent a significant diplomatic posture shift, potentially creating space for limited de-escalation while maintaining territorial integrity red lines. Russian destruction of Ukrainian data centers over three weeks signals a deliberate campaign targeting civilian communication infrastructure, likely intended to degrade command coordination and public alerting capabilities. The delayed Kyiv air alert system, which provided only seconds of warning before drone impacts, highlights critical vulnerabilities in Ukraine's early warning architecture that require urgent remediation.
